After Mom died, Dad would get drunk and yell at me.
Yet a few days before he disappeared, it was as if
he had lost his voice entirely.
Nobody has seen Dad for a whole month.\!
Suicide is the only explanation. But even if he were still
alive today, I wouldn't turn back.
I feel no sorrow.\!
Just like when Mom killed herself, all I felt was rage. \!"Again,
it happens again, leaving me alone to suffer."
Both Mom and Dad abandoned me.\!
Yet I didn't end up empty-handed.
...At least Dad left me his guns.
Half a year ago, my mother took her own life.\!
A month ago, my father walked out and never returned.
No matter how you look at it, this was never a happy home. Yet
still, I clung to the hope that "one day things will get
better."
...Yet this world\.
tramples even such modest wishes into the dirt.
The only food left is instant ramen, canned goods,
and curry. The fridge is packed with expired condiments,
starving for anything fresh.
My mentally ill mother frequently cut herself with kitchen knives.\!
After that, no knives were kept in the kitchen.
The gas was shut off a long time ago.\!
So to heat the chemicals required for bomb making,
I had to buy a portable tabletop gas stove.
The landline was cut off due to unpaid bills.\!
Though, the only calls that ever came were debt
collectors demanding money and pushing loans.
The phone rang hundreds, maybe thousands of times,\!
and all I ever heard was money, money, money...
Every time, I explained that my parents were dead, and
every time, they scoffed and called me a liar.
A reason to hesitate pulling the trigger is something
I could never find in this society.
All these magazines are several years old.\!
Not a single new one.
Dusty junk carelessly piled into a heap.\!
No matter how much I searched through it, I couldn't find
a single family photo from my childhood.

Even though everyone says,
"Life is a precious miracle given to us."
If there were no life, there would be no pain.\!
If there were no life, no blood would ever be spilled.\!
If there were no life, no one would have to suffer loss.
Well, if you still want to preach that, when you or
someone you love meets tragedy, ends up crippled, or
dies a horrible death......
Then celebrate!
After all, that's the dogma of your "miraculous life."
Ah, life is wonderful. \!Life is miraculous.\!
Even when subsonic bullets blow brains out.
Even when pipe bombs rip bodies to shreds.
It's been years since our last family dinner.
\!Ever since, I have always eaten alone.
After Mom killed herself, the thought crossed my mind
more than once to go hunt down and butcher a couple
of happy random families on the street.
The very concept of a "happy family" disgusts me.
...Yet in the end, my sights settled on the school.\!
Destroying just one or two families would never satisfy
the fury burning inside me.
I'll destroy dozens\!—no—hundreds of families!\!
Countless households will plunge into grief!
......In summary.
The endless days of isolation spent here weren't in
vain.

Without noticing, thoughts of killing people consumed me.
Long before my mother committed suicide,
I pictured myself standing with a knife in pocket and a
shotgun in hand, surrounded by mounds of corpses.
Guilt from these fantasies never burdened me.\!
Not because I lack a conscience.
There is simply nobody around me worth caring about.\!
And that is why my conscience is completely clear.
If I had a real friend, I would never harm them.
...Yet I have no friends.\!
So I will slaughter everyone without batting an eye.

The school can be seen from here.\!
The school I despise so deeply.
It's tragic: while my life crumbled away,
this view remained utterly unchanged.
Every school bell heralded the crowd of students,
laughing loudly at my misfortune.
...Yet sooner or later, everything comes to an end.\!
Starting today, we will become true friends.\!
And suffer together as one.

If I kill myself right now,\!
the school teachers will undoubtedly preach————
"What a tragedy.",\. "She had her whole life ahead.",\. and all
that sort of useless, hollow pity.
"Life is precious.",\. "You're not alone.",\.
"If you have troubles, just talk to someone.",\.
"If you see someone hurting, reach out to them."
Hidden behind these worn-out clichés recited countless times,
not a single heart will genuinely ache for my demise.
With the passing of time, every trace of my existence
will slowly wash away into oblivion.\!
Before you know it, that I ever existed is forgotten.
...However,\!
I refuse to accept an ending like that.\!
Even if that is what everyone wants.
Even if I have only a single bullet left,
I will use it to shoot everyone.
After all the pain I have endured.\!
After all the rage and hatred I have harbored.
I will not die in vain.\!
Don't even dream of it.
A pile of overdue notices.\! The grace period
before the power cutoff has already passed.
First the gas, and now the electricity too will
abandon this house very soon.
Usually I just sit in my room without bathing.\.
Yet this morning, I took a refreshing shower.\.
Today is the first and last day of my life when I
become the star on center stage.
My mother hanged herself right in this bathroom.\!
I was the first one to find her.
...Not that it surprised me all that much.\!
I had known for years that this day was inevitable.
And I was prepared for it.
Yet even so, my mother's death scarred me deeply.\!
At that moment, all the rage and hatred that had built up
inside me finally broke free.
My mother died holding a grudge against the entire world.\!
...A different end awaits me.
I will make crowds of people die despising me,\!
and I will laugh as I watch their final breaths.
Witnessing how my mother perished, there was no way
I would let myself become just another number in suicide
statistics.
My life is merely a stepping stone for someone else,\!
leaving me only to watch others smile until
the day I drop dead.\!
I have zero desire to put up with that.
...Yet sometimes I catch myself wondering,\!
that no matter how hard I struggle, my fate was already sealed:
a tragic finale, never having glimpsed even
the faintest sliver of hope or salvation.
...However,\!
Even if that is God's will, I will never accept such a
fate!\!
Why was I ever born?\!
Why were any of you born?
Neither God nor anyone else dictates the meaning of life.\!
I decide it, and only I.
